description: Ingest a Claude.ai web data-export ZIP into the session ledger. Replaces the deprecated HTTP upload route at POST /api/v1/ledger/claude_ai_export/upload. Two input shapes — exactly one MUST be supplied: (1) file_path — absolute path on the solet-side filesystem (LOCAL profile); the verb reads the bytes through blob_storage_service.store_blob_from_file. (2) content_bytes — base64-encoded ZIP bytes inline, used when coordinator and solet do not share a filesystem (cloud-solet path); hard cap 100 MiB decoded. The ZIP is stored content-addressed (external_id=session-ledger-export-sha256-<digest>) so re-ingesting the same bytes reuses the existing blob. claude_ai_export is a PUSHED source: registration is idempotent on the blob id and opens NO batch (it reuses the existing session_ledger__source row, root_uri=<blob_id>); the push itself (ingest_raw_chunk → dispatch_pushed, bound to that exact source_id) owns and COMPLETES its own batch synchronously. Any push failure PROPAGATES into the result — a successful return guarantees the conversations landed. Returns {source_id, batch_id, blob_id} where batch_id is the real push batch.
embedding_description: Ingest a Claude.ai conversation archive from an operator-provided full-account export ZIP into the session ledger: conversations.json holds per-conversation message arrays in claude.ai's native shape, which the importer flattens into ledger events. Accepts either a local file path or base64 content bytes, and is idempotent by content digest.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Mapping with three keys: source_id (the session_ledger__source row id), batch_id (the real PUSH session_ledger__import_batch row id, completed by the synchronous dispatch), blob_id (the content-addressed blob_storage_service blob_id for the ZIP bytes).
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: Report the source_id + batch_id + blob_id. The ingest is SYNCHRONOUS: by the time the verb returns, the push has completed its batch (no running batches left). A successful return means the data landed; a re-ingest of the same ZIP is idempotent (reuses the blob + source row).

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Claude.ai export ingest via ingest_export EDGE verb.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: Structured error tokens: both_path_and_bytes / neither_path_nor_bytes — XOR contract violated; supply exactly one. missing_filename_with_bytes — filename is required when content_bytes is supplied. invalid_base64 — content_bytes did not decode cleanly. payload_too_large — decoded content_bytes exceeded the 100 MiB cap. blob_store_failed / blob_store_from_file_failed — blob_storage_service refused or returned a malformed envelope; check on-disk path + namespace permissions. source_registration_failed — session_ledger_service.register_claude_ai_export_source raised or returned a malformed envelope; check Postgres connectivity + the source-registration smoke. chunk_path_unresolved — the verb could not resolve a filesystem path for the push (blob_storage_service.resolve_blob_path returned nothing); the bytes were stored but the push could not read them. import_kickoff_failed — ingest_raw_chunk (the bound push) raised or returned no batch_id; the conversations did NOT land. Both push errors PROPAGATE rather than returning a false success.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: Re-fire with the correct XOR shape. For payload_too_large: split the ZIP or use the file_path path. For blob_store_failed: verify blob_storage_service health via service_interface::blob_storage_service::list_blobs. For source_registration_failed: verify Postgres health + re-run the session_ledger repository smokes. For chunk_path_unresolved / import_kickoff_failed: re-fire the verb (registration + blob storage are idempotent so the retry reuses the existing source/blob and re-drives the push); confirm convergence via service_interface::session_ledger_service::census.
